summary: Full end-to-end test of the Greek Shift Scheduler (backend + mobile-web frontend). Backend: 13/14 pytest passed (93%). Frontend: full happy path (login → dashboard → doctors → wizard 4 steps → schedule edit → day cell bottom sheet → PDF export) works with no console errors. Greek UI strings, seeded doctors, 2026 holidays, auto-generation, validation, PDF export, JWT auth all verified.

minor.issue: The endpoint ignores the Authorization: Bearer header. The `current` parameter is declared as Optional[dict]=None but NOT wired to Depends(get_current_user), so a request with only the Bearer header (no ?token= query param) returns 401. This is not user-facing because the frontend uses ?token= via Linking.openURL, but any direct API client following the Bearer convention will be blocked. Fix: add `current: dict = Depends(get_current_user)` or fall through from header if present.

action_items: (Optional, non-blocking) Wire `Depends(get_current_user)` on /api/schedules/{id}/export-pdf so Bearer-header auth also works, in addition to the existing ?token= query-param path used by the mobile app.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py export_pdf signature is misleading: `current: Optional[dict] = None` is never bound to a dependency, so the Bearer-header branch never triggers. Either remove it or wire it via Depends.
POST /api/schedules silently deletes existing draft for same (year, month) on re-create — works per design but worth a confirmation dialog on the client to avoid accidental overwrites.

startup() re-hashes the admin password only if verify_password fails — good. bcrypt hash confirmed generated at runtime ($2b$ style) — no $ expansion issues since ADMIN_PASSWORD comes from .env via os.environ.
server.py is ~500 lines — still manageable but could be split into routers (auth, doctors, schedules) as the app grows.
Schedule `shifts` count is asserted only inside auto-generate; initial create leaves shifts=[] — fine, wizard triggers /generate next.
seed_data_creation: No manual seeding. Backend auto-seeds chief admin + 7 Greek sample doctors on startup. One test schedule for 2026-06 was created via wizard during frontend testing and remains in the DB (status=draft, can be safely left or deleted).

rca_of_issue: Minor: export_pdf handler bug. Root cause: FastAPI endpoint was defined with two optional arg-style params (token, current) but `current` is not bound to a dependency, so when the client sends only Authorization: Bearer (no ?token=) the handler falls into `if current is None: if not token: raise 401`. Reproduction: `curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer <jwt>' <API>/schedules/<id>/export-pdf` → 401. Works: same URL with `?token=<jwt>` → 200 PDF. Mitigation: either add `current: dict = Depends(get_current_user)` (recommended) or extract Bearer token manually in the body when `current` is None. Impact on UX: none, because mobile client uses Linking.openURL with ?token=.
